[Medisource Supply (Asia) Co. Ltd.](https://www.medisource-asia.com/) is a Hong Kong-based medical equipment and device supplier founded in 2003. They supply clinical and critical care products (such as professional hospital patient monitors, defibrillators, and electrocardiographs) rather than consumer smartwatches, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), or retail fitness wearables. [](https://www.medisource-asia.com/product-category/medical-equipment/)

- **Patient Monitors:** Hospital-grade modular and bedside systems (like Mindray BeneVision series) for ICU and general wards.

- **Diagnostic Equipment:** Professional electrocardiographs and ultrasound diagnostics.

- **Emergency Devices:** Defibrillators and resuscitation consumables. [](https://www.medisource-asia.com/services/)

### Consumer Wearables vs. Medical Grade

- **Consumer tech** (smartwatches, sleep trackers, and wearable ECG bands) focuses on personal daily wellness and lifestyle metrics.

- **Institutional remote patient monitoring (RPM)** utilizes integrated IoT gateways and medical-grade sensors tied directly to clinical networks rather than standard commercial wristbands. [](https://www.amazon.in/CALMORA-Glucose-Monitoring-Silicone-Waterproof/dp/B0GSK87NLG)
